srList.sentence: Materials and Methods An institutional review board-approved survey was prospectively administered to 100 consecutive patients who underwent a predetermined selection of soft tissue hand procedures performed by a single orthopedic hand surgeon at a Level I academic institution over 5 months from September 2018 to January 2019.
